# JSON to CSV

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/json-to-csv/

Convert a JSON array of objects into UTF-8 CSV using the combined set of property names as columns. Choose a delimiter and spreadsheet formula handling.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Export a list of people with name, role and country fields to a CSV spreadsheet.

## Limits and checks

Nested values remain JSON text. Formula-like strings can be neutralized with an apostrophe; select raw values only when you intend to preserve them.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
